output.reason: [ev-030a6d8de1b4] shows the removed option set in three ways: the static File configuration (YAML `providers.http.tls.caOptional: true`, TOML `[providers.http.tls] caOptional=true`) and the CLI flag `--providers.http.tls.caOptional=true`. The remediation is to remove it from the HTTP provider static configuration. The proposed condition only checks the CLI flag, so it misses environments that set the option in a static config file and is too narrow. The evidence doesn't name the ConfigMap data key that holds the file, so the file names in my correction are a best guess, and the line pattern can also match caOptional set under other sections of the file.

correction.statement: The HTTP provider `tls.caOptional` static option was removed in Traefik v3.0.0. Exposed environments are those that set it, either with the CLI flag --providers.http.tls.caOptional or in a static configuration file (YAML or TOML) under providers.http.tls.
